verdict.rationale: Meltano's pricing page publishes a general model (pay for compute, not rows, includes reverse ETL, 8 hrs engineering/mo, and a Fivetran savings estimator) but there is no documented calculator or per-connector cost table that lets a lead estimate the specific cost of adding a new source before connecting it — since sources are free/open-source connectors, cost is tied to compute usage rather than to the source itself, so predictability is only implicit. Missing for 10: an explicit cost-estimation tool for a specific new source, published compute pricing rates/tiers, and independent confirmation that estimates match real bills.
